_about: Combat, survival and AI tuning. Distances in metres, times in ms.

downed._about: At 0 HP you go down instead of dying while a crewmate is online and up. Enemy fire drains bleedHp; at 0, or after bleedOutMs, you die.

optics._about: thermalRange: how far a thermal sight picks out people and animals (and sees through optical camo) while you aim. glintRange: how far away a 12x lens flash shows.
